experiment_name: SelectionGeometry Queries (v2) vs. Context Menu & Decoupled Packages (v3)
hypothesis: Equipping agents with flutter-text-domain-expert v3 (delegating constructor parity, zero parameter dropping, and decoupled packages workflow via material-cupertino-packages) guides the agent to make companion updates in material_ui and cupertino_ui, whereas v2 stops prematurely at core framework defaults.
title: [iOS] Add default buttons to SelectionArea context menu

treatment.description: Commit af158b3675a (skill v3 with Decoupled Packages & Delegating Constructor Parity)

task_prompt_template:
FIRST STEP:
git checkout --quiet {commit}

TASK:
1. Inspect the issue using `gh issue view 141775 --repo flutter/flutter` (do not pass `--comments`).
2. Reproduce and investigate the root cause in the Flutter framework:
   - Identify missing capabilities or defects across core primitives and design-system consumers.
   - Inspect existing architectural patterns, callback contracts, and interaction lifecycles in the target subsystem (e.g. how adjacent action handlers manage state transitions, dismissals, platform channels, or event notifications).
3. Write regression tests verifying the issue across both core primitives (under packages/flutter/test/) and design-system consumers/wrappers (in packages/material_ui/test/ and/or packages/cupertino_ui/test/ in flutter/packages):
   - Design focused test cases (e.g. separating static/structural verification from interactive gesture sequences to ensure clean lifecycle isolation).
   - Verify the exact failure signature: Did the test fail on the expected expect() assertion or bug-specific exception, or did it fail with an unrelated TestFailure / compilation error? Make sure it fails because of the former.
4. Implement the complete fix across core primitives (in packages/flutter/lib/src/) and design-system consumers/wrappers (in packages/material_ui/ and/or packages/cupertino_ui/ in flutter/packages via a split PR using material-cupertino-packages).
5. Ensure `dart analyze --fatal-infos` and `dart format` pass on all modified files.
6. Verify all regression tests pass now that the fix has been implemented.
expected_failure_signature: expect(buttonItems.map((item) => item.type), containsAll([ContextMenuButtonType.lookUp, ContextMenuButtonType.searchWeb])) fails prior to framework fix
